people.role: Weigher of the Shore House: the first ledger and the pearl scales at the Nguyệt Tân market
people.appearance: Spectacles of polished pearl-shell, through which she weighs you as she would a pearl.
people.backstory: A Bắc Ngạn fisher's daughter who has weighed every pearl sold at Nguyệt Tân for thirty years; she keeps the first ledger for Kha Toán Châu (kha_toan_chau) and has begun to wonder why the north beds always pay in round numbers.

ties.note: took her from the shore market
the steward she keeps the first ledger for

tree.intent: Water wards and patience; a steward who outlasts a quarrel.

people.role: Lamp-trimmer of the pool: fills and trims the shell false moon and feeds the spirit fish
people.appearance: His eyebrows were singed off by the shell lamp and never fully grew back.
people.backstory: He has trimmed and filled the false moon for thirty years so that his master Mục Tiềm Uyên (muc_tiem_uyen) can light it on every dark night, and he says what his master says: the manor sells too many pearls and breeds too few fish. He grants or refuses a fry's name by how the shell moon flickers, and has refused Thư Ảnh Đàm's (thu_anh_dam) grandmother's name three times.

ties.note: they keep the pool between them

tree.intent: Healing Water and wards; he keeps things alive.

build.note: The shell lantern on a pole.

people.role: Outer diver from Tuyết Lộc; Mông Lộc Nhi's younger brother
people.appearance: Reindeer-hide hat, and a boast ready for any silence.
people.backstory: He failed the Lake Hall's Wood test at fourteen and walked round the lake to his sister Mông Lộc Nhi (mong_loc_nhi); he still herds the family's reindeer half the year and dives the other half. He sells reindeer horn to pilgrims as spirit-fish bone, and when a pilgrim's child sickened Đào Nguyệt Lân (dao_nguyet_lan), whose fish it was said to come from, was blamed.

ties.note: his elder sister, a diver of the north beds
a man of his own village

people.role: Inner disciple of the Shore House; sorts pearls at the Nguyệt Tân market
people.appearance: Her basket smells of brine at all hours.
people.backstory: A pearl broker's daughter of Nguyệt Tân who carries oyster spat in her market basket to Lã Tư Châu (la_tu_chau) for the dead beds of Cựu Châu Trấn, and has not told her master Phan Tĩnh Ba (phan_tinh_ba).

build.note: A basket with a false bottom.

people.role: Inner disciple at the pool; knows the four hundred spirit fish by their dead names
people.appearance: Speaks to the fish by their dead names, under her breath.
people.backstory: She knows every spirit fish by its dead name and wants the next fry named for her grandmother, a Ngư Đăng diver who drowned on a moonless night; Đàm Thiềm Đăng (dam_thiem_dang) says the manor does not name fish for the careless.

ties.note: the breeder lets her name the fry

people.role: Outer diver; Lã Tư Châu's cousin and his oyster-carrier
people.appearance: Drums his heels on every step he sits on, and does not stay sat.
people.backstory: He rows oysters to the shallows of Cựu Châu Trấn at night for his cousin Lã Tư Châu (la_tu_chau) because he thinks it is a game, and he has twice nearly told the outer gate.

people.role: Inner disciple of the heir; the second-best young diver, and sure she is the first
people.appearance: Announces her breath-hold times unasked; the barrel chest comes from the diving.
people.backstory: A net-maker's girl of Băng Võng who says she stays down one breath longer than Đinh Lưu Ly (dinh_luu_ly), and is sent to the south beds while Đinh dives the north ones; she has asked Lam Hàm Sương (lam_ham_suong) why. She once cut Đinh Lưu Ly's air-line to see how long she would last; Đinh came up blue and told no one.
